title: Crossed Wires
description: Trace two wires on a grid and find intersections by Manhattan distance and by combined step count.
writeup:
## Approach

Trace each wire into a dictionary mapping `(x, y)` to the step count when that point was first visited. Intersections are just the set intersection of both dictionaries' keys.

## Part 1

For each intersection, compute Manhattan distance `|x| + |y|` from the origin. Return the minimum.

## Part 2

For each intersection, sum the step counts from both wires. The dictionary naturally stores the *first* visit's step count (later revisits are ignored), which is exactly what the puzzle requires. Return the minimum combined steps.
